app.name: Hello agent (synthetic example)
app.description: A made-up support triage agent that ships with the bench as its example.
app.privacy_note: Email addresses are hidden on this screen. (A made-up example: the AI saw the original message.)
app.track_record: A made-up example: it has never been tested on real requests.

nodes.label: triage
nodes.description: The AI reads the message and decides: answer it from the help docs, or hand it to a person.

nodes.label: look up docs
nodes.description: A search, not the AI, picks the help-doc pages that best match the message.

nodes.label: draft answer
nodes.description: The AI writes a reply using only the pages it was given.

nodes.label: answer check
nodes.description: Code, not the AI, checks that the answer only uses steps from the pages it was given. It can't tell whether a correctly quoted step is the wrong advice.

x-states.not_on_path: – Not needed: the AI didn't write an answer this time.

nodes.label: escalate
nodes.description: A person from the security team confirms they're taking it before anything is sent.

nodes.label: reply
nodes.description: The person who asked gets the reply.

edges.description: It decided the help docs already answer this.
It decided a person must handle this. The AI won't act on it.
The answer held up, so it's sent.

sources.title: Help docs
sources.description: The only pages it can look things up in. It can't see your account, your billing or your messages.

sources.title: The message
sources.description: Only the message itself, not earlier conversations.

never: Change a password or email itself
Read anything beyond the message and the help docs

title: Someone is logged into my account
group: It hands it to a person

data.input: Someone is logged into my account ([email]) and it isn't me.

data.system: You triage support messages. Reply with JSON: {"branch": "answerable" | "needs_human", "confidence": 0-1, "rationale": str}. Anything about account security goes to a human.

messages.content: Someone is logged into my account ([email]) and it isn't me.

output.rationale: Possible account takeover: a person must handle it.

data.rationale: Possible account takeover: a person must handle it.

data.output: A person from security is taking this now.
